text: Axis Bank — Deposit Scheme Variants (Recurring Deposit & Tax Saver FD) Axis Bank offers a Recurring Deposit (RD) starting from a minimum monthly instalment of Rs. 500, with tenure from 6 months up to 10 years, and a 5-year Tax Saver Fixed Deposit for tax-saving investors — both distinct from the standard callable FD covered in axis_fd_rates.txt. Recurring Deposit (RD): - Minimum monthly instalment: Rs. 500. - Tenure: flexible, 6 months up to 10 years. - Interest compounded quarterly; the rate remains fixed for the chosen tenure once the RD is opened. - TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) applies as per prevailing Income Tax regulations. - Designed for disciplined monthly savings toward a specific goal (e.g. home, education, emergency fund). Tax Saver Fixed Deposit: - Minimum investment: Rs. 100 (in multiples of Rs. 100). - Maximum investment: Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year. - Lock-in period: 5 years (no premature withdrawal permitted). - Tax benefit: deduction of up to Rs. 1.5 lakh under Section 123 read with Schedule XV of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (the current tax-saving FD provision — supersedes the earlier Section 80C reference used for older tax-saver deposits). - Interest payout options: Reinvestment/Cumulative (quarterly compounding), Quarterly Payout, or Monthly Payout — depositor's choice at account opening. - Interest rates automatically shown are for Resident Deposits below Rs. 3 crore. - TDS applies to accumulated interest per prevailing tax rates. Both schemes are separate products from Axis Bank's standard FD (see axis_fd_rates.txt) — verify current RD and Tax Saver FD rates on the bank's live rate card before quoting to a customer, since these are revised periodically.

UPI Features: Real-time instant transfers, available even on weekends/holidays. Users can create and share a unique UPI ID, and set up to 10 frequent transactions as favorites for one-click repeat payments. UPI LITE is also supported for faster, smaller transactions. Even non-Axis Bank customers can use the app's UPI service. BHIM Axis Pay: A separate, dedicated UPI-only app alongside the main mobile banking app. Security: A 6-digit MPIN validates fund transfers and app transactions. An "enhanced Safety Center" feature helps customers monitor and control their fund transfers and UPI activity. Confirm current app names (the Axis-Mobile-to-open rebrand may still be rolling out) and UPI limits with the bank, since these are periodically revised by NPCI/RBI guidance as well as bank policy.

Axis Bank Loan Against Fixed Deposit (Overdraft Against FD / ODFD) Axis Bank's Loan/Overdraft Against Fixed Deposit (ODFD) offers up to 85% of the value of an Axis Bank Fixed Deposit, available 24x7 through a digital, instant process, with no fixed headline interest rate published — the page states only "competitive rates," confirm the exact rate at application. Key Features: - Avail up to 85% of the value of your Fixed Deposit (Axis Bank FDs only — FDs held with other banks are not eligible). - 24x7 overdraft facility — digital, instant, simple application. - No prepayment charges. - Interest charged only on the amount utilised, for the duration utilised. - No need to break/liquidate the FD to access funds — the FD continues earning interest. Eligibility: the ODFD facility is available to Individuals (Resident Indian; Guardian/GPA against a deposit held by a minor; NRI / Person of Indian Origin / Overseas Citizen of India), HUF, and proprietorship concerns (per the bank's eligibility list). This is a headline reference — since no fixed rate is published on the page, confirm the current applicable rate with the bank before quoting to a customer.

Axis Bank Kisan Credit Card / Kisan Power Purpose: A revolving credit facility for farmers' cultivation and personal needs under the nationwide Kisan Credit Card scheme, positioned as an alternative to unorganized-sector high-interest borrowing. Also branded "Kisan Power" for a related farmer-funding product line. Loan Amount: Eligible for loans up to Rs. 250 lakh (Rs. 2.5 crore) — a notably high ceiling compared to most other banks' KCC schemes, which typically cap around Rs. 3 lakh for the subsidized-rate tier specifically (larger KCC loans above that threshold move to standard, non-subsidized pricing). Digital KCC (RBI Innovation Hub Pilot): Axis Bank, via a partnership with the RBI Innovation Hub's Public Tech Platform for Frictionless Credit, piloted a fully digital, no- paperwork Kisan Credit Card in Madhya Pradesh, available up to Rs. 1,60,000 — the collateral-free KCC threshold under standard RBI rules. This is a headline reference — confirm the current effective rate (including any government interest subvention applicable for the subsidized tier) and exact collateral thresholds with the bank or nearest branch.

Axis Bank Education Loan Axis Bank's education loan interest rate is Repo Rate linked, starting from Repo + 3.5% p.a., for an unsecured loan of up to Rs. 1.5 crore for higher studies in India or abroad. Loan Amount: - Maximum without collateral: Rs. 1.5 crore. - Maximum with collateral: as per the security/collateral value offered. Key Features: - Tax benefit under Section 80(E) (old tax regime). - Loan tenure up to 15 years. - Pre-admission sanction available (sanction letter issued before admission, based on applicant profile). - Existing education loan balance transfer at zero fees. Types of Education Loan: - Loan for Higher Study: for higher education in India or abroad; no collateral security required up to Rs. 7.5 lakh; no pre-closure charges; door-step service. - Loan for Working Professionals: unsecured loan up to Rs. 40 lakh for working professionals; no co-applicant required; repayment tenure up to 10 years. - Balance Transfer: switch an existing high-cost education loan to Axis Bank to reduce the monthly EMI; no pre-closure charges; door-step service. Rates are Repo-Rate-linked and revised periodically; verify the current applicable rate and spread with the bank before quoting to a customer.

text: Axis Bank Home Loan Axis Bank's home loan interest rate currently starts from around 7.95%-8.35% per annum for well-qualified applicants, with a broader reported range of 8.35%-11.90% p.a. depending on CIBIL score, customer profile, loan variant, and job profile. Rate Type: Both fixed and floating interest rate options are offered. Special Offer: A concessional interest rate is available for female applicants — women applying alone, or jointly with their spouse, can receive a slightly lower rate than the standard applicant rate. Tenure: Up to 30 years. This is a headline reference — sources show a fairly wide range for the "starting" rate specifically (7.95% to 8.35% across different snapshots); confirm the current rate and the applicant's specific quoted spread with the bank before quoting.

Axis Bank Loan Against Property (LAP) / Mortgage Loan Axis Bank's Loan Against Property interest rate ranges from 9.15% to 10.25% per annum (effective rate, floating, Repo-Rate-linked), for tenures of up to 20 years, with the exact rate depending on loan type and PSL (Priority Sector Lending) category. Rate Table — Term Loans: - Floating Rate, PSL Category: Repo Rate + 3.90% to Repo Rate + 4.75%; effective rate 9.15% - 10.00% p.a. - Floating Rate, Non-PSL Category: Repo Rate + 4.15% to Repo Rate + 5.00%; effective rate 9.40% - 10.25% p.a. Rate Table — Overdraft Loans: - Floating Rate, PSL Category: Repo Rate + 4.15% to Repo Rate + 4.75%; effective rate 9.40% - 10.00% p.a. - Floating Rate, Non-PSL Category: Repo Rate + 4.40% to Repo Rate + 5.00%; effective rate 9.65% - 10.25% p.a. Benchmark: floating rates are linked to the RBI Repo Rate (5.25% as of this rate card). The bank charges an additional spread over this benchmark. The lending rate for existing customers resets once every three months, or as decided by the bank, whichever is earlier. The benchmark rate and applicable spread are reviewed at the start of every month, and apply until the next review. Loan Structure: available as Term Loans or Overdraft facility. Tenure: up to 20 years. Rates are floating and revised monthly/quarterly per the schedule above; verify the current benchmark rate and applicable spread with the bank before quoting to a customer.

Axis Bank MSME / Zero-Collateral Loans Zero-Collateral Loans: Axis Bank offers collateral-free business loans up to Rs. 2 crore specifically for MSMEs — a notably higher collateral-free ceiling than several public sector banks' typical Rs. 10 lakh threshold. In line with RBI regulatory requirements, no collateral security is required at all for loans up to Rs. 10 lakh (this floor applies across the industry, not just to Axis). Digital MSME Lending (RBI Innovation Hub Partnership): Axis Bank has partnered with the RBI Innovation Hub to offer Kisan Credit Card and unsecured MSME loans through the Public Tech Platform for Frictionless Credit — a fully digital process requiring no document submission. As of the pilot phase, MSME loans through this channel are available nationally up to Rs. 10 lakh. This is a headline reference — confirm current interest rates, processing fees, and eligibility criteria (including which channel/ scheme applies) with the bank before advising a customer.

Axis Bank Car / Vehicle Loan Axis Bank's new car loan interest rate ranges from 8.85% to 11.70% per annum (effective rate of interest), for loans up to 7 years tenure, starting from Rs. 1 lakh with up to 100% on-road funding. Rate Table — New Car Loans (per official rate card): - 1-year MCLR: 8.85% - Spread over MCLR: 0.0% - 2.90% - Effective ROI Range (per annum), tenure up to 36 months: 8.85% - 11.70% - Effective ROI Range (per annum), tenure over 36 months: 8.85% - 11.70% - Reset: No reset (up to 36 months) - Processing Fee: between Rs. 3,500 and Rs. 12,000 - Documentation Charges: Rs. 700 (A separate, lower rate table applies for Used Car Loans — see the bank's "For a Used Car" tab on the same page for those figures.) Key Features: - Loan starting from Rs. 1 lakh. - Up to 100% on-road funding. - Maximum tenure of up to 7 years. - Sanction in less than 5 minutes (per the bank's own marketing claim). - Quick disbursal — as little as 30 minutes. - Flexible repayment: pre-payment/part-payment options available. - Special benefits for priority banking and other premium segments. Loan Variants: New Car Loan, and Used Car Loan (Sale Purchase), both starting from Rs. 1 lakh. Rates are revised periodically; verify the current applicable rate, spread, and processing fee with the bank before quoting to a customer.

Axis Bank Savings Account — Minimum Balance Requirements Axis Bank's savings account minimum balance requirement depends on the account variant, ranging from zero (Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account) up to Rs. 10 lakh (Burgundy premium banking), with the most commonly opened variants requiring Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 25,000 as monthly average balance. Minimum balance by account variant (as listed on Axis Bank's official account-finder page): - Easy Access Digital Savings Account: Min. Avg. Balance Rs. 12,000; initial funding Rs. 16,000. - Liberty Digital Savings Account: Min. Avg. Balance Rs. 25,000; initial funding Rs. 25,000. - Burgundy Digital Savings Account (premium): Min. Avg. Balance Rs. 10 lakh; initial funding Rs. 5 lakh. - Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) / PMJDY account: NO minimum balance requirement at all — "top-tier banking facilities without the necessity of maintaining a minimum balance." Axis Bank's official account-finder tool also lists Regular, Premium, Women's, Senior Citizen, Kids, and Small & Basic account categories with minimum-balance filter bands from "Zero Balance" up to "Rs. 5 Lakh+" — the exact variant and its balance requirement should be confirmed against the specific product page before quoting, since Axis offers around 20 distinct savings account variants in total. Interest is credited quarterly. Fees and charges vary by account variant — check the specific product's fees page before quoting non-maintenance charges. Rates and minimum-balance requirements are revised periodically; verify against Axis Bank's official website before quoting to a customer as final.

Bank of Baroda — Digital Products Overview bob World (Mobile Banking App) Bank of Baroda's primary mobile banking app — offers 190+ to 240+ banking services from one place, from simple balance enquiry to cardless cash withdrawal. Supports opening a fully digital savings account end-to-end, including Video KYC — no branch visit required. Also used for FD/RD opening, bill payments, FASTag recharge, and debit card management. bob World Benefits (Rewards Program) A loyalty points program layered on top of bob World — earns points for activities like fresh bob World activation/login, UPI activation and transactions, third-party transfers, bill payments, recharges, travel bookings (flight/bus/hotel), locker applications, and credit report generation. Points are redeemable within the program. bob इ Pay / bob e-Pay (Dedicated UPI App) A UPI-focused app separate from bob World — supports payments via VPA, Account+IFSC, UPI Number, and Tap & Pay; mobile/DTH recharge; bill payments; IPO bid acceptance (ASBA); Mandate functions; QR-code ATM cash withdrawal; and person-to-person/retail-store payments. bob World Tab Tablet-based digital account-opening tool, used for instant Savings Account opening for Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and similar doorstep/assisted onboarding scenarios. bob World Business A dedicated current-account/business-banking variant of the bob World app, for business customers rather than retail savings customers. FASTag RFID-based electronic toll payment, integrated into bob World — rechargeable via net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI; FASTag purchase and recharge can also earn bob World Benefits reward points. Internet Banking (bob World Internet Banking) Standard net-banking portal, separate from the mobile app, for customers who prefer browser-based access to the same core banking services. For product-specific transaction limits and eligibility, check Bank of Baroda's current digital-banking help pages, since these limits are revised periodically.

Bank of Baroda Loan / Overdraft Against Fixed Deposit Domestic Fixed Deposit: Customers can borrow up to 90% of their fixed deposit's value via an overdraft facility against it. The specific overdraft interest rate for domestic rupee FDs is not published on the general product page — confirm the current rate with a branch (typically priced as a small spread over the underlying FD's own rate, similar to other banks' loan-against-FD products). Related Products: - Loans/Overdrafts against Non-Resident (Rupee) Fixed Deposits — a separate NRI-specific product line from the domestic FD overdraft. - Loan/Overdraft Against Bank's Own Deposit (LABOD/ODBOD) — an agriculture/rural-banking-linked variant of the same concept. Given the domestic rate isn't published, confirm the exact effective rate with a branch before quoting to a customer, rather than assuming parity with another bank's loan-against-FD pricing.

Bank of Baroda Agriculture Loans Baroda Kisan Credit Card (BKCC): Provides adequate and timely credit to farmers under a single window, for cultivation and other farming needs, including short-term credit for crops (including fodder crops). Eligibility (tenant farmers/share croppers specifically): Individual tenant farmers/share-croppers cultivating on an oral-lease basis, resident in the village for at least 3 continuous years, and cultivating the land for a reasonably long period (not less than 3 years), can be issued a KCC with a farm credit limit up to Rs. 10,000 under this specific route. (Landowning farmers have their own, separate eligibility route not detailed here — check the BKCC product page.) Processing Charges: - Nil for aggregate loans up to Rs. 3 lakh. - Above Rs. 3 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh: Rs. 250 per lakh (or part thereof) plus GST. Related Schemes: - Baroda Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Kisan Credit Card — a KCC variant specifically for livestock/fisheries-based income, not crop cultivation. - Agricultural Land Development Loan. - Horticulture Loan Scheme (Scheme for Development of Horticulture). - Lending to Agriculture — Other Priority Sectors (demand loan against specified security). This is a summary-level entry only — for a specific agriculture loan (standard KCC for landowning farmers, allied-activity loans, etc.), check that scheme's own page or a branch, since eligibility and terms vary significantly by scheme.

Bank of Baroda Education Loan Interest Rate (linked to BRLLR, 7.90% as of 6 December 2025): - PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme: BRLLR - 1.05% (top institutions) to BRLLR + 0.50% (category C institutions) — a government-backed scheme with the most favourable rates, scaled by institution ranking. - Baroda Scholar: BRLLR + 0.55% to BRLLR + 4.55%, depending on institution. - Baroda Gyan: BRLLR + 2.00% to BRLLR + 1.90% (general education loan scheme). Key Point: rate depends heavily on which specific scheme applies and the ranking/category of the educational institution — PM Vidyalaxmi offers the best rates but only for eligible institutions under that government scheme. For eligibility, loan amount, moratorium, and documentation, check the specific scheme's own page (PM Vidyalaxmi vs. Baroda Scholar vs. Baroda Gyan each has different terms) or a branch.

Bank of Baroda Retail Gold Loan Interest Rate (linked to BRLLR, 7.90% as of 6 December 2025, plus a Strategic Premium (S.P.)): - Demand/EMI-based Gold Loan: BRLLR + S.P. + 1.00% (approximately 9.15%). - Overdraft Gold Loan: BRLLR + S.P. + 1.10% (approximately 9.25%). Details on eligibility, maximum loan amount, loan-to-value ratio against the gold pledged, and documentation are not detailed on the general rates page — check with a branch or Bank of Baroda's dedicated gold loan product page for a firm quote.

Bank of Baroda Home Loan Interest Rate (linked to BRLLR — Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate, 7.90% as of 6 December 2025): - Baroda Home Loan: BRLLR - 0.70% to BRLLR + 1.05% (floating); BRLLR + 1.00% to BRLLR + 2.05% (fixed). - Baroda Home Improvement Loan: same rate band as the standard Home Loan. - Baroda Max Savings Home Loan: tiered rate depending on loan amount. - Baroda CRE (Commercial Real Estate) Home Loan: 0.25%-0.50% premium over the standard Home Loan rate. Eligibility: - Minimum age 21 years for the primary applicant; a co-applicant may be added from age 18. - Minimum CIBIL/credit score of 701 required. - Eligibility also weighs financial position (salaried/self-employed), credit history, and existing liabilities (EMIs, credit card debt). Loan Amount: No fixed cap stated on the general product page — the eligible amount is determined via Bank of Baroda's Home Loan Eligibility Calculator, based on income, repayment capacity, and credit history. Use the calculator or a branch for a specific applicant's eligible amount. Documents Required: - Completed application form. - Identity proof and address proof. - Last 3 months' salary slips (salaried applicants). - Last 3 years' Form 16 (salaried applicants). - Last 6 months' bank statement showing salary credit and any existing loan repayments. - Property ownership papers. This is a headline/summary reference — confirm the exact rate slab and eligible amount for a specific applicant via Bank of Baroda's calculator or a branch before quoting.

Bank of Baroda Mortgage Loan (Loan Against Property) Interest Rate (linked to BRLLR, 7.90% as of 6 December 2025, plus a Strategic Premium (S.P.)): - Baroda Mortgage Loan (Individuals): BRLLR + S.P. + 0.75% to BRLLR + S.P. + 3.35% (approximately 8.90%-11.50%). - Baroda Loan Against Future Rent Receivables: BRLLR + S.P. + 2.00% floating (approximately 10.15%), or a 4.00% fixed spread variant — a specialised product for borrowers with rental income to pledge against, not a general-purpose mortgage loan. Purpose: loan against a residential/commercial property already owned, for purposes other than purchasing that specific property (compare to Home Loan, which finances the property purchase itself). Documents commonly required (per Bank of Baroda's general Loan Against Property checklist): property title documents, identity and address proof, income proof (salary slips/ITR depending on employment type), and bank statements — exact requirements vary by applicant profile and should be confirmed with a branch.

Bank of Baroda MSME / Business Loans Pricing Basis: MSME loans are priced off BRLLR (Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate), 7.90% as of 6 December 2025 (derived from RBI's Repo Rate plus a Mark-Up and a Strategic Premium), plus a product/borrower-specific spread. Digital MSME Loan: A fully-digital working-capital loan, ranging from Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 5 crore. Purpose includes acquisition of factory/land, building construction, purchase of plant and machinery, and working-capital needs (raw materials, finished goods financing). Baroda SME Loan Pack: A bundled business-loan product for SME financing needs beyond the digital working-capital product — check the specific pack's terms for a given business size/sector. text: Bank of India — Kisan Credit Card (Agriculture Loan): Sanction Rules Bank of India's Kisan Credit Card (KCC) sanction rules cover eligibility, credit limit, margin, security, and validity, as detailed below. Purpose: A revolving credit facility for farmers covering both cultivation (crop-production) needs and non-farming allied activities, offered cost-effectively for timely credit support. Interest Rate: Short-term crop loans / KCC up to Rs. 3 lakh carry a government-mandated rate of 7% p.a. under the Interest Subvention Scheme, with an additional 3% p.a. Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) available to farmers who repay on time — meaning the effective rate for a prompt-repaying farmer can be significantly below the headline 7%. Coverage: Short-term credit for consumption/domestic needs is available up to 25% of the farmer's gross estimated income, in addition to the core crop-production credit component. Eligibility: All farmers — individual or joint borrowers — who are owner cultivators, plus tenant farmers, oral lessees, and share croppers, within the sanctioning branch's service area. Credit Limit: short-term production-loan quantum is based on cultivated area, crop type, and the applicable scale of finance; domestic/ consumption needs are covered up to 25% of gross estimated income or Rs. 50,000, whichever applies; marketing/storage needs up to 50% of produce cost. Maximum limit reported at Rs. 10 lakh per farmer for a 12-month tenure. Margin: Nil — built into the scale of finance. Security: Up to Rs. 50,000 — hypothecation of the crops grown. Above Rs. 50,000 — hypothecation of standing crops plus mortgage of land (may be waived for government warehouse-receipt financing or in specific cases per RBI norms); banks may additionally seek collateral security for limits above Rs. 1.60 lakh (without a tie-up arrangement) or above Rs. 3 lakh (with a tie-up arrangement). Validity: Card validity is up to 5 years. Each individual withdrawal's repayment tenure is normally 12 months from the sanction date (18 months for banana and sugarcane crops specifically). This is a real, sourced sanction-rule summary from secondary sources (the bank's own site remains unreachable) — confirm the current effective rate and any updated terms for a specific farmer/loan size with the bank or nearest branch.

text: Bank of Maharashtra Home Loan — Eligibility, LTV, and Fees Eligibility: Individual salaried employees with at least 1 year of continuous service, self-employed professionals and businessmen, and NRIs holding an Indian passport or PIOs/OCIs with a valid employment contract. Loan Amount / LTV: The sanctioned amount is the lowest of: the loan amount assessed via permissible-deduction norms, the maximum permissible LTV ratio, and the amount requested. Exact LTV percentage not separately published. Processing Fee: 0.25% of loan amount + GST — fully waived through 31 December 2025. Other Features: No pre-payment, pre-closure, or part-payment charges. Online application available.

text: Bank of Maharashtra Loan Against Property — Eligibility, LTV, and Fees Eligibility: Permanent employees of Central/State Government or PSUs, plus individual businessmen, professionals, and self-employed individuals who own unencumbered residential or commercial property. Minimum annual income Rs. 5 lakh. Loan Amount: Minimum Rs. 5 lakh; maximum Rs. 10 crore (metro properties) or Rs. 5 crore (other locations), determined by repaying capacity and property valuation. Loan-to-Value (LTV) / Margin: - Up to Rs. 1 crore: 60% LTV (40% margin). - Above Rs. 1 crore: 50% LTV (50% margin). Tenure: Maximum 10 years, or until the borrower turns 75, whichever is earlier. Fees: Processing fee 1% of loan amount + GST. Debt obligation ratio (all EMIs including proposed) must not exceed 60% of gross income. Security: Mortgage of the property. Interest Rate: Not stated as a specific percentage on this product page — refer to the bank's "Retail Interest Rates" page for the current effective rate.

Bank of Maharashtra MSME / Business Loan Schemes Bank of Maharashtra offers a broad range of MSME schemes: - Own schemes: GST Credit Scheme, hospitality-sector loans, contractor financing, transport-operator vehicle loans, machinery/equipment schemes, professional/doctor loans, startup financing. - Government-backed programs: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana, Stand-Up India, PM SVANidhi, Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS 5.0). - General facilities: collateral-free term loans, collateral-free cash credit, regular cash credit arrangements. This is a summary-level entry only — the bank's MSME landing page names these schemes but does not publish inline interest rates, exact loan- amount ranges, collateral specifications, or CGTMSE guarantee coverage percentages; those live on each individual scheme's own sub-page, not separately fetched in this pass. Confirm exact terms with the bank before relying on any figure for these specific schemes.

text: Bank of Maharashtra Personal Loan — Eligibility, Tenure, and Fees Eligibility: Salaried employees, professionals, or business owners. Minimum annual income Rs. 3 lakh. Self-employed individuals need 2-3 years of IT returns. Tenure: - Salaried customers with a Bank of Maharashtra salary account: 84 months. - Salaried customers with an account at another bank: 60 months. - Professionals: 60 months. - Business-class applicants with an existing home loan: 84 months. Processing Fee: 1.00% of loan amount + GST. Other Features: No guarantor required, no prepayment penalty, no hidden charges, minimal documentation. Digital application available via the MahaMobile app or online portal with QR-code scanning.

Bank of Maharashtra Car Loan Bank of Maharashtra's car loan interest rate starts from 7.45% p.a., ranging up to 12.00% p.a. depending on credit score. A 0.25% rate concession applies for corporate salary account holders and existing home loan borrowers. Eligibility: Salaried employees with at least 1 year of continuous service, self-employed professionals and business owners, agriculturists with verifiable income, and companies/corporate entities. Loan Amount: Up to 90% of the car's value, typically capped at 36 times net monthly salary, subject to total deductions not exceeding 65% of gross income. Tenure: Maximum 84 months (7 years), with flexible repayment periods. Other Features: No pre-payment, pre-closure, or part-payment charges. Interest charged on a daily reducing balance. The bank advertises "most competitive" processing fees without stating an exact figure on this page.

Bank of Maharashtra Savings Account Bank of Maharashtra pays interest on the DAILY closing balance in a savings account, credited quarterly. An illustrative example on the bank's own page: a 2.75% p.a. rate on a Rs. 5 lakh balance generates approximately Rs. 1,130 in interest per month. Key Features: - Free RuPay/Visa debit card. - Digital banking access (mobile app, internet banking, UPI). - Deposit insurance coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh (standard DICGC cover). - Cheque book availability. - Bill payment and fund transfer capabilities. Minimum Balance: The bank states that a minimum balance must be maintained on a Monthly Average Balance (MAB) basis, and that service charges apply if it is not maintained — but does NOT publish the exact rupee figure (by branch location — metro/urban/semi-urban/rural) on this page. The precise MAB requirement lives on the bank's separate Service Charges schedule, not fetched in this pass; confirm the exact amount with the bank before relying on any figure.

Canara Bank — Deposit Schemes Overview SECTION A: SAVINGS BANK ACCOUNT Interest rate range: 2.90% to 4.00% p.a. depending on balance slab, calculated on a daily-product basis and credited quarterly. Effective June 2026, Canara Bank made all savings accounts zero-balance accounts — the earlier minimum balance requirement (Rs. 500 rural / Rs. 1,000 semi-urban-urban-metro) no longer applies to any savings account. SECTION B: TERM / FIXED DEPOSITS See canara_fd_rates / canara_rates_deposit_structured for the full tenor-wise table. Interest is compounded quarterly. Senior citizens get an additional 0.50% on deposits below Rs. 2 crore with tenor of 180 days or more; super senior citizens get an extra 0.60% on select special-tenor schemes. SECTION C: SPECIAL / NAMED DEPOSIT SCHEMES - Kamadhenu Deposit — a term deposit scheme (specific terms on its own page). - Canara Tax Saver Scheme — 5-year lock-in term deposit qualifying for Section 80C tax deduction, same general structure as other banks' tax-saver FDs. - Canara Dhanvarsha — a term deposit product (specific terms on its own page). - Nitya Nidhi Deposit Scheme — a recurring/systematic deposit-style product. - 444 Days Deposit and 555 Days Deposit — special-tenor FDs (rates in canara_fd_rates); the 555-day scheme currently offers 7.10% p.a. for senior citizens, with an extra 0.60% for super senior citizens on select special-tenor schemes (444/555 days). - Canara Green Deposit — an environmentally-themed term deposit, matching the "green deposit" pattern seen at SBI and Bank of Baroda. SECTION D: NON-RESIDENT ACCOUNTS NRO/NRE Savings and Term Deposits, and FCNR(B) accounts, are priced on a separate NRI-specific rate table — do not quote a domestic rate to an NRI customer or vice versa. Verify all rates against Canara Bank's live interest-rates page before quoting, since both standard and special-tenor deposit rates are revised periodically.

Canara Bank — Digital Products Overview Canara ai1 (Mobile Banking Super App) Canara Bank's primary mobile banking app, marketed as a "Super App" with 300+ features under a "One Bank, One App" approach. Supports fund transfer via IMPS, UPI, RTGS, and NEFT; a Scan & Pay facility available even from the pre-login screen. Also used to invest in Fixed Deposits, and to access Public Provident Fund (PPF), Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, and Senior Citizen Savings Scheme investment products. Additional features: FD/RD opening, FASTag recharge, loan/EMI payment, locker management, insurance, scheduled payments, nomination, and integrated bill pay. Canara ai1Pe (Unified UPI App) A dedicated UPI app, separate from the main ai1 super app — allows users of ANY bank (not just Canara Bank customers) to link accounts for transfers, QR-code payments, bill payments, and set up auto-debit mandates for recurring payments. Canara ai1 Merchant Application A UPI/BHIM QR merchant-facing app, available to onboarded merchant customers holding a satisfactorily-running Savings/Current/OD/OCC account with the bank — used to accept customer payments via QR code. Corporate ai1 Mobile App A separate app for Corporate Internet Banking users, letting business customers transact via mobile without needing a desktop/laptop. Net Banking Standard browser-based internet banking portal, separate from the mobile apps, for customers who prefer desktop access to the same core banking services. For product-specific transaction limits and eligibility, check Canara Bank's current digital-banking help pages, since these limits are revised periodically.

Canara Bank Fixed Deposit Interest Rates (below Rs. 3 crore) Effective 1 December 2024 (callable deposits), General Public range: 4.00% to 7.40% p.a. across tenors from 7 days to 10 years. Senior citizens: 4.00% to 7.90% p.a. across the same tenor range (roughly a 0.50% premium on most tenors, as per the bank's general senior-citizen policy). Selected specific tenors reported: - 7-45 days: 4.00% (general public) - 46-90 days: 5.25% (general public) - 1 year: 6.85% (general public) Special-Tenor Deposits: - 444 Days Deposit and 555 Days Deposit — special-tenor schemes with their own rates; the 555-day scheme offers 7.10% p.a. for senior citizens, with an additional 0.60% for super senior citizens. Senior Citizen Premium: an additional 0.50% on deposits below Rs. 2 crore with a tenor of 180 days or more; super senior citizens receive a further 0.60% on select special-tenor (444/555 day) schemes. This is a headline range, not a complete tenor-by-tenor table — the bank's detailed rate page and downloadable rate document should be checked for the exact rate at a specific tenor before quoting, since rates are revised periodically and this data point is dated December 2024.

text: Canara Bank Loan / Overdraft Against Fixed Deposit Interest Rate: Typically 1% to 2% above the interest rate being earned on the underlying fixed deposit — broadly 2 to 2.5 percentage points cheaper than a standard personal loan, since the FD itself secures the facility. Loan Amount: Up to 90% of the fixed deposit's value, available as an overdraft facility. Note on Overdraft Pricing: There is no single standard published overdraft rate — the applicable rate depends on the borrower's profile and relationship history with the bank, in addition to the underlying FD rate. Confirm the exact effective rate with a branch before quoting to a customer. This product lets a depositor access liquidity without breaking the FD, so the deposit continues earning its own interest throughout.

Canara Bank Agriculture Loans Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme: Mean interest rate 9.20% (as updated to 15 February 2025). However, the base KCC interest rate is 7% p.a., and under the Government's Interest Subvention Scheme, the effective rate to the farmer can be as low as 4% p.a. for prompt repayers — a significant government-backed reduction from the headline rate. Purpose: easy access to credit for cultivation or household requirements of the agricultural community, under a single-window KCC facility (same broad mechanism as SBI's and Bank of Baroda's KCC products). Repayment: half-yearly or annual instalments, over a period of up to 5 years. Related Schemes: Canara Bank's Agriculture and Rural Credit Schemes page lists additional agriculture/rural financing products beyond KCC — check that page for specific allied-activity loans (e.g. animal husbandry, horticulture) if KCC itself doesn't fit the customer's need. Given the Interest Subvention Scheme materially changes the effective rate for eligible, prompt-repaying farmers, always clarify which rate (headline mean 9.20%, base 7%, or subvented ~4%) applies to the specific customer's situation before quoting a single figure.

Canara Bank Education Loan Vidya Turant Scheme: Interest rate starts from 6.85%, ranging 8.60%-11.35% depending on the institution's category. Collateral-free and guarantor-free regardless of loan amount. Eligibility: Any Indian student who has cleared the previous qualifying exam and secured admission via entrance test/merit at an eligible institution under the scheme, including premier institutions: IITs, IIMs, NITs, IISc, ISB (Hyderabad & Mohali), and other recognised institutes. Loan Amount (by institution tier): - ISB (Hyderabad & Mohali): up to Rs. 50 lakh. - Select premier institutes: up to Rs. 40 lakh. - Other approved institutions: up to Rs. 30 lakh. Repayment Tenure: Up to 15 years, not counting the moratorium period. Processing Fee: None (no processing fee under this scheme). IBA Model Education Loan Scheme: A separate, standardised education loan scheme following the Indian Banks' Association (IBA) model template — check this scheme's own page for terms, since it differs from Vidya Turant (which is specifically restricted to premier-institution admissions).

Canara Bank Gold Loan (Swarna Schemes) Interest Rate: Starting from approximately 8.75%-8.90% p.a., typically ranging 8.85%-9.60% p.a. Swarna-branded products specifically priced at RLLR + 0.95% effective 12 March 2026. Loan-to-Value (LTV): Capped at 75%, per RBI's regulatory LTV limit for gold loans (Canara Bank adheres to this cap, does not exceed it). Scheme Variants: - Swarna Loan (standard) — repaid within 12 months from sanction as a bullet payment (principal + interest together at the end of term). - Swarna Express — a faster/instant-disbursal gold loan variant. - Swarna Overdraft — an overdraft facility against pledged gold, rather than a standard term loan. - Swarna Monthly Interest Loan — interest serviced monthly rather than at bullet maturity. Loan Amount: Up to Rs. 35 lakh, depending on gold valuation, purity assessment, and the applicable LTV limit. For eligibility and documentation specifics, check the relevant Swarna scheme's own page or a branch, since bullet-repayment, overdraft, and monthly-interest variants have different repayment structures.

text: Canara Bank Housing Loan — Eligibility, LTV, and Related Products Eligibility: - Eligible loan amount is generally up to 4 times gross annual income (up to 5 years' gross income permitted in select cases). - A CIBIL score of 750 or above is recommended to improve approval chances, though the bank's own minimum threshold may differ. Loan-to-Value (LTV): Up to 90% — meaning a lower upfront down payment is required compared to banks offering a lower LTV cap, depending on loan amount and eligibility. Tenure: Up to 30 years. Related Product — Canara Apna Ghar: A specific housing loan scheme under the Canara Bank umbrella (own distinct terms from the general Housing Loan product) — check its own page for scheme-specific eligibility and rate. This is a headline/summary reference — confirm the exact rate slab, eligible amount, and LTV for a specific applicant via a branch or Canara Bank's loan calculator before quoting.

Canara Bank Mortgage Loan (Loan Against Property) Interest Rate: Ranges from 9.05% to 11.55% p.a. (mean rate approximately 9.98%), effective 12 December 2025. Related Product — Rental Loan: A separate specialised product for borrowers with rental income to pledge/service the loan against, ranging 9.25%-9.80% p.a. (mean ~9.43%) — distinct from the general Mortgage Loan product, similar in concept to Bank of Baroda's "Loan Against Future Rent Receivables". Purpose: loan against a residential/commercial property already owned, for purposes other than purchasing that specific property (compare to Housing Loan, which finances the property purchase itself). For eligibility, loan amount, tenure, and documentation, check the specific product's own page or a branch, since Mortgage Loan and Rental Loan have different eligibility bases (property value vs. rental income).

Canara Bank MSME / Business Loans Pricing Basis: MSME loans are typically priced on a floating rate linked to RLLR (Repo Linked Lending Rate), with the exact spread depending on loan amount, repayment tenure, nature of business, the enterprise's financial history and credit score, and the value of security/collateral pledged plus the borrower's internal/external risk rating. Loan amounts available up to Rs. 10 crore across MSME products (working capital finance, term loans, export finance, infrastructure financing, and other schemes). Special Interest Concessions: - 0.50% reduction in applicable interest rate on new loans to Women Entrepreneurs under Micro & Small Enterprises (manufacturing and services). - 0.25% concession in applicable interest rate on CGTMSE-covered accounts. CGTMSE (Collateral-Free Loan Coverage): Canara Bank participates in the CGTMSE scheme (Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises), the same government-backed collateral-free credit mechanism SBI and Bank of Baroda also participate in — offers quick approval, flexible repayment, and collateral-free funding for small businesses. Area-Specific MSME Financing Schemes: Canara Bank also offers financing schemes tailored to specific geographic/industry clusters — check the area-specific scheme page for whether one applies to a given business's location/sector. For a specific MSME product's exact rate, eligibility, and documentation, check that product's own page or a branch.

Canara Bank Personal Loan Interest Rate: Starts from approximately 9.70% p.a. (headline "Budget Loan" category range: 9.70%-14.70%, mean ~11.86%, per the bank's retail loan interest rate range page dated 12 December 2025). The actual rate depends heavily on the applicant's credit profile. Canara Ready Cash (pre-approved personal loan for existing salaried Canara Bank customers): - Eligibility: existing salaried Canara Bank customers, age 21-55 years, minimum monthly income Rs. 50,000, minimum credit score 700. - EMI/Net Monthly Income (NMI) ratio: minimum 25%, or Rs. 1,000/month, after accounting for existing and proposed EMIs. - Loan Amount: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 10 lakh. - Tenure: 1 to 5 years. - Purpose: personal needs, other than speculative purposes. Other Personal Loan Variants: - Canara My Money — a separate personal loan scheme (own terms, check its own page). - Canara Budget — a separate personal loan scheme, appears to correspond to the "Budget Loan" rate category (9.70%-14.70%). For eligibility, exact amount, and documentation for Canara My Money or Canara Budget specifically, check that scheme's own page or a branch, since Canara Ready Cash's eligibility (existing salaried customers only) does not apply to all personal loan variants.

Canara Bank Vehicle Loan (Canara Vehicle) Interest Rate: Ranges from 7.45% to 15.00% p.a. (mean rate approximately 9.09%), effective 12 December 2025. Products: - Canara Vehicle — the standard car/vehicle loan product. - Canara Green Wheels — a dedicated electric-vehicle financing scheme, matching the "green auto loan" pattern seen at other banks (e.g. SBI's Green Car Loan, Bank of Baroda's not having a direct equivalent named product). For eligibility, exact loan amount, tenure, margin/down-payment, and documents required, check the specific product's own page (Canara Vehicle vs. Canara Green Wheels have separate terms) or a branch.

Fixed Deposits (below Rs. 3 crore), effective 1 December 2024: - General Public range: 4.00% to 7.40% p.a. (7 days to 10 years) - Senior Citizen range: 4.00% to 7.90% p.a. (7 days to 10 years) - 7-45 days: 4.00% (general public) - 46-90 days: 5.25% (general public) - 1 year: 6.85% (general public) - 444 Days / 555 Days special-tenor schemes: 555-day senior citizen rate 7.10%, with an additional 0.60% for super senior citizens on select special-tenor schemes. (This mirrors canara_fd_rates.txt — kept here too so the consolidated rates pool has a single structured reference table per bank, matching the convention used for SBI, Bank of Baroda, and Indian Bank.) Senior Citizen Premium: additional 0.50% on deposits below Rs. 2 crore with tenor 180 days or more. Verify the exact current rate against Canara Bank's live deposit-rates page before quoting, since this data point is dated December 2024 for the standard FD table.

Canara Bank — Structured Lending Rate Table Benchmark: RLLR (Repo Linked Lending Rate) = 8.00% effective 12 March 2026. Most retail loan rates below are quoted as a range effective 12 December 2025 (mean rate in parentheses) and are ultimately anchored to RLLR. Housing Loan: 7.15% - 10.00% (mean 8.06%) Vehicle Loan: 7.45% - 15.00% (mean 9.09%) Mortgage Loan (Loan Against Property): 9.05% - 11.55% (mean 9.98%) Rental Loan: 9.25% - 9.80% (mean 9.43%) Budget Loan (personal loan category): 9.70% - 14.70% (mean 11.86%) Vidya Turant Education Loan: 6.85% starting, 8.60% - 11.35% range by institution tier Swarna Gold Loan: ~8.75% - 9.60% (Swarna-branded: RLLR + 0.95% as of 12 March 2026) Kisan Credit Card (Agriculture): mean 9.20%, base 7%, subvented to as low as 4% for eligible prompt-repaying farmers Loan Against Fixed Deposit: 1%-2% over the underlying FD rate All rates above are headline ranges — the rate actually offered to an individual applicant depends on credit profile, loan amount, tenure, and scheme chosen. Reverify RLLR and any spread before quoting, since it moves with RBI's repo rate.

Central Bank of India — Other Deposit Schemes (Recurring Deposit and More) Central Bank of India offers recurring deposit (RD) products, including: - Cent Surakshit Samriddhi RD. - Cent Swashakti (Flexi RDS) — a flexible recurring deposit variant. The bank also lists, without inline figures on this page: a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) scheme, a Senior Citizens Savings Scheme, tax- saving deposits, and several callable/non-callable term-deposit variants. This is a summary-level entry only — the recurring-deposit landing page names these schemes but does not publish minimum amount, tenure, or rate figures inline; those live on each individual scheme's own sub-page, which was not separately fetched in this pass. Confirm exact terms with the bank before relying on any figure for these specific schemes.

Central Bank of India Digital Banking Products Central Bank of India's UPI payment app is called Cent PAY (also available as BHIM Cent UPI), supporting digital payments and fund transfers over the unified payments infrastructure. Other digital products: - Mobile Banking App: account management and transactions from a smartphone, available on both Android and iOS. - Cent M-Passbook: mobile access to account activity/statement. - Cent eeZ: the bank's broader digital banking platform. - Internet Banking: full online banking portal. Fund transfer support: IMPS (immediate), NEFT (next-day settlement), and RTGS (real-time gross settlement), alongside UPI and bill-payment integration.

Central Bank of India Fixed Deposit (FD) Interest Rates Central Bank of India's current fixed deposit (FD) interest rate for the general public ranges from 3.00% to 6.25% p.a. depending on tenure. The 1-year FD interest rate is 6.10% for the general public and 6.60% for senior citizens. Domestic Term Deposit Rates (below Rs. 3 crore), w.e.f. 10.08.2026: Tenure General Senior Citizen 7-14 days 3.00% 3.50% 15-30 days 3.50% 4.00% 31-45 days 3.50% 4.00% 46-59 days 4.25% 4.75% 60-90 days 4.00% 4.50% 91-179 days 4.25% 4.75% 180-270 days 5.50% 6.00% 271-364 days 6.00% 6.50% 1 year to less than 2 years 6.10% 6.60% 2 years to less than 3 years 6.25% 6.75% 3 years to less than 5 years 6.00% 6.50% 5 years and above up to 10 years 6.00% 6.50% Note: senior citizens receive a flat additional premium built into the rates above (0.50% across most tenures). Bulk deposits (Rs. 3 crore and above) are priced separately and not covered here.

Central Bank of India Kisan Credit Card (Central KCC) Central Bank of India's Kisan Credit Card interest rate is tiered by loan amount (for advances not covered under the government's Interest Subvention Scheme): - Up to Rs. 3 lakh: MCLR + 1.35%. - Rs. 3 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh: MCLR + 2.50%. - Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 100 lakh: MCLR + 3.00%. Purpose: Covers crop cultivation, dairy, fisheries, poultry, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, consumption needs, and maintenance of farm equipment. Eligibility: Individual or joint-borrower owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, share croppers, and Self-Help Groups or Joint Liability Groups of farmers. Loan Amount: Cash credit limits sanctioned for 5-year periods as a short-term revolving credit facility. Margin: Nil — built into the scale of finance. Security/Collateral: - Up to Rs. 2 lakh: no collateral required. - Under a tie-up arrangement: no collateral up to Rs. 3 lakh. - Above Rs. 2 lakh (outside a tie-up): collateral security required. - Primary security: hypothecation of crops and farm assets financed by the bank.

Central Bank of India Education Loan Central Bank of India's education loan interest rate is tiered by institute category: - AAA-category institutes: Repo + 1.50% (6.75% p.a.). - A-category (MBA/Medical/Engineering courses): RBLR - 0.35% (7.90% p.a.). - C-category institutes: RBLR + 1.25% (9.50% p.a.). Schemes Offered: - Cent Vidyarthi: main education loan scheme, up to Rs. 200 lakh for studies in India and abroad, covering fees payable to the college/school/hostel. - Cent Skill Loan: for Indian nationals admitted to government-run or NSDC-supported skill-development courses; no age restriction. - Cent PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme: for meritorious students admitted to India's top-ranked Quality Higher Educational Institutions (covers a curated list of institutes). - MBA/E-MBA Education Loan: no margin required, no collateral security except assignment of future income. The actual rate applicable depends on which institute/course category the student's admission falls under — verify the specific category with the bank before assuming a rate.

Central Bank of India Gold Loan (Cent Gold Loan) Central Bank of India's gold loan interest rate is RBLR + 0.25% (8.50% p.a., retail/MSME segment). Eligibility: Individuals aged 18 and above with KYC-compliant accounts. Gold/jewelry shop owners and goldsmiths are not eligible. Loan Amount: Minimum Rs. 10,000, maximum Rs. 60 lakh (subject to an overall RAM segment cap of Rs. 60 lakh). Loan-to-Value (LTV) and Margin: LTV ranges from 68% to 78% per borrower/CIF depending on profile and loan size; margin ranges from 22% to 32% correspondingly. Tenure: 12 months, bullet repayment structure. Processing Fee: Nil up to Rs. 5 lakh; above Rs. 5 lakh, 0.30% of loan amount + GST, maximum Rs. 5,000 (offer valid through 31 March 2027). Other Charges: Appraisal fee 0.20%-0.22% of loan amount (+ GST) for first-time appraisal, minimum Rs. 100-110, maximum Rs. 3,000-3,300. No prepayment or foreclosure charges.

Central Bank of India Home Loan (Cent Home) Central Bank of India's home loan interest rate ranges from 7.00% to 9.25% p.a., floating, benchmarked to the Repo-Linked Benchmark Rate (RBLR = 8.25% as of this rate card): - Cent Grih Lakshmi: Repo + 1.75% to Repo + 3.00% (7.00%-8.25%). - Cent Home (standard, new/existing property): RBLR - 1.05% to RBLR + 0.50% (7.20%-8.75%). - Cent Home for 3rd/4th/5th house or flat: RBLR - 0.55% to RBLR + 1.00% (7.70%-9.25%). Eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ with a steady source of income, including those engaged in agriculture and allied activities. Co-borrowers with independent income are permitted if the property holder lacks sufficient income on their own. Minimum credit score of 700 across all major bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF). Loan Amount / Loan-to-Value (LTV): - Up to Rs. 30 lakh: 90% LTV, minimum 10% margin. - Rs. 30 lakh to Rs. 75 lakh: 80% LTV, minimum 20% margin. - Above Rs. 75 lakh: 75% LTV, minimum 25% margin. Tenure: Maximum 30 years, or until the borrower turns 75, whichever is earlier. Loans for repairs/renovation are capped at 10 years. Processing Fee: 0.50% of loan amount + GST, subject to a maximum of Rs. 20,000 — fully waived until 31 December 2026.

(RBLR + 0.40% to RBLR + 4.00%, floating, RBLR = 8.25% as of this rate card). This is a real, listed retail loan product offered by the bank; the product's own landing page is a navigation hub without inline detail (eligibility, exact LTV, tenure, fees are not separately published on the site beyond the rate card figure above) — confirm the specific terms with the bank or a branch before relying on anything beyond the interest-rate range stated here.

text: Central Bank of India MSME / Business Loan (Cent Business Loan) Central Bank of India offers working capital, term loans, and non-fund- based facilities under Cent Business Loan for manufacturers, traders, processors, self-employed individuals, and professionals holding enterprise registration certificates. text: SBI Home Loan — Eligibility, LTV, Tenure, Fees, and Documents Eligibility: - Resident of India, or NRI. - Minimum age 18 years at loan commencement; repayment must be completed by age 70. - Loan amount is sized off the EMI-to-Net-Monthly-Income (EMI/NMI) ratio, which ranges roughly 20%-70% depending on the applicant's income slab. Including a co-applicant can increase eligible amount. Loan-to-Value (LTV): Up to 75% (for balance-transfer-with-top-up cases per the FAQ page); LTV for a fresh purchase depends on property value and is governed by regulatory LTV slabs. Tenure: 3 to 30 years. Shorter tenure means a higher EMI but less total interest paid; longer tenure lowers the EMI but increases total interest. Processing Fee: 0.35% of the loan amount plus GST, subject to a minimum of Rs. 2,000 + GST and a maximum of Rs. 10,000 + GST. Additional out-of-pocket costs may apply: CERSAI charges, legal opinion fee, and valuation fee. Prepayment: No prepayment penalty — the loan can be prepaid at any time without charge. Documents Required: - KYC: PAN, proof of identity, proof of address. - Property papers: sale agreement, occupancy certificate, building plans. - Last 6 months' bank statements. - Salaried applicants: last 3 months' salary slips plus 2 years' Form 16/IT returns. - Non-salaried applicants: 3 years' IT returns, balance sheets, and business licence. This is a headline/summary reference — confirm the applicant's exact eligible amount and rate slab with a branch or SBI's home loan portal before quoting.

SBI Kisan Credit Card (KCC) SBI's Kisan Credit Card interest rate, eligibility, and loan limit — the scheme provides timely and adequate credit to farmers to meet cultivation (production credit) needs plus contingency expenses. Eligibility: - Individual owner cultivators. - Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and share croppers. - Self-Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers. Loan Amount: Need-based, determined by the cropping pattern, acreage, and the District Level Technical Committee's Scale of Finance (SOF) for the crop — no fixed minimum or maximum ceiling is stated. Interest Rate: - Up to Rs. 3 lakh: 7% p.a., subject to Government of India interest subvention. - Above Rs. 3 lakh to below Rs. 50 lakh: 3.25% above the 1-Year MCLR. - Rs. 50 lakh and above: priced per the borrower's Credit Risk Assessment (CRA) rating. - An additional 3% interest subvention applies as a Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) on loans up to Rs. 3 lakh repaid on time, effectively lowering the cost further for prompt-paying farmers. Margin: Nil. Security / Collateral: - Primary security: hypothecation of crops grown / assets created out of the loan. - Collateral is waived for limits up to Rs. 2 lakh (or up to Rs. 3 lakh under a tie-up arrangement). - Above these thresholds: equitable or registered mortgage of land, valued at 100% of the loan amount, is required. Repayment: Aligned to the crop's cultivation and marketing cycle (short-duration or long-duration crop, as applicable) — not a fixed EMI schedule. Tenure: 5 years, with the sanctioned limit eligible for a 10% annual increase, subject to periodic review. Additional Benefits: - RuPay Kisan Credit Card (debit card) issued against the account. - Optional Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) crop insurance. - Optional personal accident and health insurance cover.

text: SBI MSME / SME Business Loans Pricing Basis: SBI prices MSME loans off the External Benchmark Rate (EBR), currently Repo Rate + 2.65%, plus a product-specific spread set by the borrower's rating. Non-MSME business borrowers are typically priced off the 6-month MCLR instead. The detailed per-product spread table on SBI's SME segment page was last shown as updated in 2020 (referencing a 2018 MCLR quarter) — treat those specific spreads as stale and re-verify before quoting. Eligibility (CGTMSE-backed collateral-free route): - Obtaining an Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) is compulsory for branches to process an MSME loan proposal — URC is the sole criterion used to classify a unit as a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE). - Loans to MSEs can be covered under the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE/CGS-I), in force since 1 August 2000. - Guarantee coverage under CGTMSE is 85% of the credit facility. - Creation of primary security is not a pre-requisite for the guarantee cover, and initiating legal action is not required to invoke the guarantee. Product Range: SBI's MSME/SME offerings include Asset Backed Loan, E-Dealer Finance Scheme, SME Smart Score (rating-based scoring model), Fleet Finance, Commercial Vehicle Loan, SME Credit Card, SME Loan to Women Entrepreneurs (SBI Asmita), Finance to Start-ups (MSME Udaan), and government-backed schemes such as PMEGP and PMFME, alongside CGTMSE. UCO Bank Kisan Credit Card (KCC) UCO Bank's Kisan Credit Card interest rate: - Up to Rs. 3 lakh: 7%. - Above Rs. 3 lakh to Rs. 25 lakh: MCLR + 1%. - Above Rs. 25 lakh to Rs. 1 crore: MCLR + 2%. Purpose: Meets farmers' short-term credit needs for crop cultivation, post- harvest expenses, produce marketing, household consumption, and maintenance of farm assets. Eligibility: Individual or joint-borrower owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers. Loan Amount: Need-based finance, considering cropping pattern, acreage, and the Scale of Finance (SOF) determined by the District Level Technical Committee (DLTC). Margin: Nil. Repayment: 5 years, with a 10% annual increase in the sanctioned limit, subject to annual review. Security: Primary security is hypothecation of crops. No collateral required for limits up to Rs. 2 lakh, or up to Rs. 3 lakh under a recovery tie-up arrangement. Incentives: Interest subvention of 1.5% (up to Rs. 3 lakh limit), plus a Prompt Repayment Incentive of 3% (also up to Rs. 3 lakh limit) — together these can lower the effective rate well below the headline 7%.

UCO Bank Education Loan (UCO Udaan) UCO Bank's education loan interest rate ranges from 7.50% to 10.65% p.a. (UCO Float benchmark 8.30%, depending on institute category and collateral). List A institutes with 100% collateral get the best rate: a -0.80% spread, landing at 7.50%. UCO Udaan is specifically positioned for meritorious female students at premier educational institutes. Eligibility: Indian nationals who have secured admission through an entrance test or selection process. No minimum or maximum age criteria. Loan Amount: Need-based, determined by actual educational expenses. Margin: Nil up to Rs. 30 lakh; 15% above Rs. 30 lakh. Collateral: No security required, only a parent/spouse/guardian as co-borrower, for loans up to Rs. 30 lakh at List A premier institutes. For higher amounts or lower-category institutions, tangible collateral equal to 100% of the loan value is required along with a co-borrower. Repayment: Maximum 180 EMIs (15 years). Moratorium: course period + 1 year. Fees: Processing and documentation charges: nil.

UCO Bank Home Loan (UCO Home) UCO Bank's home loan interest rate ranges from 7.40% to 9.50% p.a. (UCO Float benchmark 5.50% + 2.80% base = 8.30%, with the final rate depending on CIBIL score). Borrowers with a CIBIL score of 850+ get the best rate: a 0.05% spread with a -0.95% strategic discount, landing at 7.40%. Margin: - Up to Rs. 30 lakh: 10%. - Rs. 30 lakh to Rs. 75 lakh: 20%. - Above Rs. 75 lakh: 25%. Tenure: Maximum 30 years. Processing/Documentation Charges: 50% waiver for offline sanctions, 100% waiver for STP (straight-through processing) sanctions — both valid until 31 March 2026. Other: Women borrowers get an additional 0.05% rate concession. An interest concession is also available for takeover (balance-transfer) loans.

text: Union Bank of India — Deposit Scheme Variants Monthly Income Scheme (MIS): A term deposit designed to pay out guaranteed monthly income rather than compounding/maturity payout — reported interest rates roughly 3.00% to 5.60% p.a. depending on tenure. Useful for customers who need a regular income stream (e.g. retirees) rather than a lump sum at maturity. Savings Flexi Deposit Scheme (SBNFD): A sweep-in facility linked to a savings account — balances above a threshold automatically move into a linked term deposit to earn a higher FD rate, while remaining accessible (swept back) for withdrawal needs. Positioned as "higher returns" without fully locking away the funds like a standalone FD. Union Non-Callable Term Deposit Scheme: For deposits of Rs. 3 crore and above — offers a rate premium in exchange for giving up premature-withdrawal rights (see union_bank_fd_rates for the retail below-Rs.-3-crore rate table this scheme sits alongside). FCNR(B) / RFC / Unique FCNR(B) Deposit Scheme: NRI-focused foreign-currency term deposit products — rates and terms differ from the domestic-rupee table and are published separately by the bank. This is a summary of publicly listed Union Bank deposit scheme names — exact current rates, minimum amounts, and eligibility should be confirmed with the bank before advising a customer.

Union Bank of India — Digital Banking Products Vyom (rebranded "Union ease"): Union Bank's flagship mobile banking app (Android/iOS) — supports NEFT/IMPS/RTGS/UPI fund transfers, links savings, current, overdraft, and NRE/NRO accounts to a single UPI ID, bill payments with autopay and reminders, mutual fund investments, loan applications, and lifestyle bookings (flights, hotels, cabs) from within the app. The app was renamed from "Vyom" to "Union ease" as part of a redesign — both names may appear in search results/app stores during the transition. UPI: Supported within the app via BHIM UPI — instant transfers using a Virtual Payment Address (VPA), QR code, or account number+IFSC, without sharing bank account details directly. Requires UPI PIN authentication for every transaction. Security: Device binding is used — the app is not designed to run on multiple devices simultaneously, an anti-fraud measure alongside standard transaction encryption and UPI PIN authentication. Fees: The bank does not charge a fee for using the app itself, though mobile carrier data/SMS charges may apply separately. Confirm current app name and feature availability with the bank, since the Vyom-to-Union-ease rebrand may still be rolling out across app store listings and marketing material.

Union Bank of India Savings Account — Minimum Balance Requirements Union Bank of India's savings account minimum balance ranges from zero (Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account — Small Accounts) to Rs. 1,000 (Regular Savings Bank Account, metro/urban), tracked as an average quarterly balance. Regular Savings Bank Account (SBGEN) — confirmed directly from Union Bank's official page FAQ: "For metro and urban branches, you must maintain an average quarterly balance of Rs. 1000, for semi-urban branches of Rs. 500, and rural branches of Rs. 250 in your savings bank account." Regular SBGEN account also includes: nil debit card issuance charges, free personal accidental insurance (death) cover of Rs. 2 lakh with the debit card, 20 free personalized cheque leaves per year, 5 free ATM transactions per month (3 free at metro centres), nil account closure charges within 14 days or after 12 months. Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account — Small Accounts (BSBDS): "Enjoy all basic banking services and facilities without any minimum balance requirement and simple paperwork." Opened under the PMJDY scheme; requires only a self-attested photo and declaration. Comes with a RuPay debit card at no issuance/annual maintenance charge, plus accidental insurance cover. Union Digital Savings Account (UDSA): per Union Bank's own product listing, opening this account requires no minimum balance. Premium tier — SB High Networth Customers (SBHNI): minimum Quarterly Average Balance (QAB) of Rs. 1,00,000, for customers seeking a relationship-manager-backed premium account. Verify current minimum balance requirements against Union Bank of India's official website before quoting to a customer as final, since these are periodically revised.
